hooks.command: d=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}; [ -f "$d/tsconfig.json" ] || exit 0; for b in "$d"/node_modules/.bin/tsgo "$d"/node_modules/.bin/tsc; do [ -x "$b" ] && break; b=; done; [ -n "$b" ] || exit 0; ps=$(grep -o "\"path\": *\"[^\"]*\"" "$d/tsconfig.json" | sed "s/.*\"\\([^\"]*\\)\"\$/\\1/"); out=$(cd "$d" && for p in ${ps:-.}; do "$b" --noEmit --pretty false -p "$p" 2>&1 || echo "${b##*/} -p $p failed"; done); [ -z "$out" ] || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | head -20 >&2; exit 2; }

d=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}; [ -f "$d/tsconfig.json" ] || exit 0; for b in "$d"/node_modules/.bin/tsgo "$d"/node_modules/.bin/tsc; do [ -x "$b" ] && break; b=; done; [ -n "$b" ] || exit 0; ps=$(grep -o "\"path\": *\"[^\"]*\"" "$d/tsconfig.json" | sed "s/.*\"\\([^\"]*\\)\"\$/\\1/"); out=$(cd "$d" && for p in ${ps:-.}; do "$b" --noEmit --pretty false -p "$p" 2>&1 || echo "${b##*/} -p $p failed"; done); [ -z "$out" ] || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | head -20 >&2; exit 2; }

d=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}; if [ -f "$d/pnpm-lock.yaml" ]; then l=pnpm-lock.yaml; s=node_modules/.modules.yaml; i="pnpm install"; elif [ -f "$d/package-lock.json" ]; then l=package-lock.json; s=node_modules/.package-lock.json; i="npm ci"; else exit 0; fi; if [ -L "$d/node_modules" ]; then t=$(cd "$d/node_modules" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); cmp -s "$d/$l" "${t%/node_modules}/$l" 2>/dev/null || echo "typecheck-on-edit: node_modules links to another checkout whose $l differs from this one (or the link is dangling). Install here: rm node_modules && $i"; elif [ ! -e "$d/$s" ] || [ "$d/$l" -nt "$d/$s" ]; then echo "typecheck-on-edit: $l is newer than $s (or node_modules is missing). Run $i before trusting type-check results in this checkout."; fi
